status: Decision rules registered before seed-43/44 fitting or sensitivity metric inspection

seed_source.scope: Borrow its prespecified sensitivity seeds. The comparator's direct host-baseline parent specifies seed 42 only; this is a new registered sensitivity study, not a claim that its parent already specified this experiment.

frozen_baseline.rule: Refit the original representations, training-only preprocessing, C=0.1, lbfgs and max_iter=2000 under the original numerical package lock. Record the actual interpreter; block on an unavailable declared environment rather than silently replacing it.

B2_policy: Seed-invariant, verified from retrieval_splits and by comparing B2 partitions after reassigning host groups with 42/43/44. Do not refit B2 in either study.
cohort: Same locked 177 hosts, 94 phages, 16597 observed MLC labels and 41 unknown exclusions
manifest_guard: For each seed recompute group_hosts and split_by_host_group and require exact equality with that seed's committed manifest. Preserve _freeze_cohort's equality check and ComparatorBlocked exception.
representation_reuse: Import hash-verified, split-independent clustering and full protein-family feature artifacts from v1 through a separate checkpoint; do not rerun clustering, search or feature assignment.
comparator_decisions: All numeric/modeling decisions are inherited bit-identically from genophi_comparator.v1: fixed cutoff 3, 20 <= n < 501, 200 features per RFE run, five FS runs, ten retained models, three complete repeats, all-30-model median confidence, unchanged CatBoost grid, no dynamic weights or SHAP, outer-training rows only.
baseline_refits: Both sensitivity seeds refit the entire original baseline study's grouped-host scenario, including annotations, genome and hybrid. Cite only matching-seed refits. Every compared learned baseline model must name exactly that seed's training hosts and have no target-host overlap.
prevalence_check: Independently recompute Beta(1,1)-smoothed per-phage positive rates from each seed's training observed rows and verify its complete candidate scores and metrics against both study outputs.
primary_estimand: Grouped-host test all-complete-host macro Hit@2: genophi_median minus phage_prevalence, separately for seeds 43 and 44

decision_rule.family: The two new-seed primary test contrasts only; seed 42 is an already observed descriptive reference
decision_rule.multiplicity: Holm adjustment across the two exact group sign-flip p-values; valid under dependence between the overlapping seed panels
decision_rule.holds_on_prespecified_seeds: Both new seeds complete and pass QA; each has strictly positive primary delta, a strictly positive lower endpoint of the existing paired 95% group-bootstrap interval, and Holm-adjusted two-sided group sign-flip p <= 0.05.
decision_rule.does_not_hold_directionally: Both seeds are reported and at least one completed new seed has primary delta <= 0; identify the tie or reversal explicitly. This is a counterexample to an all-seed directional advantage.
decision_rule.not_established: All new primary deltas are positive, but at least one confidence or Holm criterion fails. The robustness criterion is not met; this is not proof of equality or no effect.
decision_rule.blocked: Any planned seed or required baseline cannot complete or pass QA. Report all completed results and the blocked seed/reason; do not classify the sweep as holding or replace the seed.
decision_rule.inference_scope: Agreement on these two prespecified sensitivities supports robustness only to these splits, not a property of every split or independent release validation. No pooling hosts, repeats or overlapping seeds as independent replicates.

prevalence_swing_rule.estimand: For each seed, all-complete-host prevalence test Hit@2 minus validation Hit@2
prevalence_swing_rule.reproduced: Both new seeds have a test-minus-validation swing <= -0.10 (at least a 10-percentage-point drop, approximately the seed-42 magnitude).
prevalence_swing_rule.seed42_drop_not_reproduced_with_stable_s: Both new seeds have absolute swing <= 0.05. Describe seed 42's >10-point drop as not reproduced among these sensitivities; do not claim a formal population outlier test from three seeds.
prevalence_swing_rule.mixed_or_different: Every other complete pattern; report each signed swing and distance from seed 42 without selecting a favorable summary.
prevalence_swing_rule.rationale: Ten points identifies a drop comparable to the observed 11.09-point reference; five points defines a materially smaller validation/test difference. The intermediate region remains explicitly mixed. These fixed thresholds are descriptive effect-size categories, not significance tests.

statistics.pairwise_contrasts: Every unordered pair of the four reported methods, for every metric, partition and denominator; all except the two declared primary contrasts are descriptive unadjusted comparisons.

sign_flip.statistic: Absolute sum of per-host metric differences; group contributions are sums, preserving the host-macro estimand rather than equally weighting group means
sign_flip.calculation: Exact enumeration of all signs on nonzero group-total contributions, counted using meet-in-the-middle tail search. Zero-total groups remain in support reporting but have no effect on the permutation distribution.
sign_flip.arithmetic: Convert stored binary64 metric values to common-denominator integers, then group and compare exactly; no rounding, thresholding or dropping fractional hosts.
sign_flip.bound: Each grouped validation/test partition has 22 frozen groups; an unexpected limit violation is blocked, not silently approximated.
sign_flip.null_assumption: Group-wise sign exchangeability/symmetry of paired differences, conditional on the fitted models and fixed panel
sign_flip.mcnemar_relation: Equals exact McNemar for binary pairs with one discordant host per contributing group. Binary outcomes alone do not guarantee equality under group-level flips.

statistics.discordance: Report left-only/right-only counts on the explicitly counted both-binary subset and report the non-binary host count, including zero. Every host, fractional or binary, enters sign-flip and bootstrap according to the declared denominator.

run_accounting.policy: Start and report both seeds regardless of either outcome. No outcome-dependent seed omission, replacement, additional repeat, refit, cutoff change or exclusion. A blocked run stays blocked.
run_accounting.resume: An interruption before a completed result may resume only identical hash-bound checkpoints and the originally prespecified unfinished stages. After any outer result is available, inference-only QA and artifact validation are allowed; additional fitting of that seed is forbidden.
run_accounting.records: Record planned/started/completed/blocked status for every seed and both studies, tool versions, code/protocol/input/output hashes and monotonic wall time.

limits: The protein-family vocabulary remains transductive in genome sequences while the 4-mer baseline is inductive; this sweep cannot isolate protein families versus 4-mers.
Changing split seeds reuses this inspected development cohort and creates no independent release holdout.
No claim that positives-per-host is a complete explanation of a ranking swing, or that the sweep identifies its biological cause.
